cohort: The study included 3030 Japanese women aged 20-64 years who participated in a web-based survey.
finding: The prevalence of urinary incontinence among Japanese women was 25.5%, with significant associations found with age, BMI, vaginal delivery status, low back pain, and previous pelvic floor muscle training engagement.
mod_finding: Vaginal delivery status was significantly associated with urinary incontinence.
cross-section timing: The study was conducted at a single point in time via a web-based survey among women aged 20-64 years.
